title: Setup Symfony bundle skeleton with PHPStan and E2E test infrastructure
description: Prepare repository for Symfony bundle development: bundle skeleton structure, PHPStan static analysis configuration, and E2E test setup with sample Symfony application

title: Bundle skeleton + composer setup
description:
## Context
Create minimal Symfony 7.4 bundle skeleton so the bundle can be autoloaded and registered.

## Key Changes
- `src/SymfonyProcessManagerBundle.php` - add bundle class.
- `src/DependencyInjection/SymfonyProcessManagerExtension.php` - add minimal DI extension.
- `composer.json` - add PHP 8.5 and Symfony 7.4 requirements and set type to symfony-bundle.

## Patterns to Follow
- Symfony bundle best practices: https://symfony.com/doc/7.4/bundles/best_practices.html
- Namespace root per `composer.json:5-8`.

## Success Criteria
- Bundle class autoloads via PSR-4.
- `composer dump-autoload` succeeds.

## References
- Plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/research.md`

title: Fixture Symfony app + E2E test
description:
## Context
Add a full fixture Symfony app to boot the bundle and an E2E test that verifies the bundle loads.

## Key Changes
- `tests/Fixtures/app/*` - fixture app kernel and config.
- `tests/E2E/BundleBootTest.php` - boot fixture app via KernelTestCase and assert bundle registration.

## Patterns to Follow
- Symfony testing docs: https://symfony.com/doc/7.4/testing.html
- Fixture app pattern (example): https://github.com/EasyCorp/EasyAdminBundle

## Success Criteria
- Fixture app boots with bundle registered.
- `vendor/bin/phpunit` passes.

## References
- Plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-e5j/plan.md`

title: PHPStan config for fixture app
description:

title: Run CLI command in separate process and assert warning/error logs
description: Run a bundle CLI command in a separate process during tests and parse logs to fail on LoggerInterface::warning or higher.

title: Bundle command + fixture logger wiring
description:
## Context
Add the bundle `pm:serve` command and wire it via bundle DI. In the fixture app, override `Psr\Log\LoggerInterface` with a lightweight stdout JSON logger and import fixture services.

## Key Changes
- `src/Command/ServeCommand.php` - implement `pm:serve` command (no args) and log via LoggerInterface only.
- `src/DependencyInjection/SymfonyProcessManagerExtension.php` - load bundle services config.
- `src/Resources/config/services.yaml` - register command with `console.command` tag.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/src/StdoutJsonLogger.php` - lightweight stdout JSON logger.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/config/services.yaml` - override LoggerInterface to use the fixture logger.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/Kernel.php` - import `config/services.yaml`.

## Patterns to Follow
- Bundle extension load is currently empty: `src/DependencyInjection/SymfonyProcessManagerExtension.php`.
- Fixture kernel imports only packages: `tests/Fixtures/app/Kernel.php`.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] `php tests/Fixtures/app/bin/console pm:serve` outputs only JSON log lines.
- [ ] No direct console output (only logger output).

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-iul/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-iul/research.md`

title: Subprocess harness + log parsing
description:
## Context
Add a subprocess runner using `symfony/process` to execute `pm:serve` via the fixture console entrypoint and parse stdout JSON logs to fail on warning+.

## Key Changes
- `composer.json` - add `symfony/process` to require-dev.
- `tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php` - run console command in separate process, capture output, parse JSON lines, fail on warning+ levels.

## Patterns to Follow
- Fixture console entrypoint: `tests/Fixtures/app/bin/console`.
- Strict PHPUnit output rules: `phpunit.xml`.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Subprocess run returns exit code 0 for info-only logs.
- [ ] Warning+ log record produces a readable failure message.

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-iul/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-iul/research.md`

title: Test cleanup + subprocess E2E
description:

## Key Changes

## Patterns to Follow

## Success Criteria
